reason: The cited evidence shows that Al addition to a coating on Zr-alloy can improve corrosion resistance via a denser oxide layer (E1), but it does not demonstrate in situ Al2O3 formation, its role as a diffusion barrier against Cr–Zr interdiffusion, or performance in high-temperature steam. The key mechanistic premises are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Al addition to a Cr coating can promote formation of an Al2O3 layer
An Al2O3 layer can act as a diffusion barrier to reduce Cr–Zr interdiffusion
Al addition does not compromise corrosion resistance under PWR conditions
Al addition does not compromise oxidation resistance under high-temperature steam
